name: Google Drive
summary: Search a Google user's Drive, read file metadata, download files and export Google Docs, Sheets and Slides as text, Markdown, CSV or PDF.

client_id.description: the OAuth client id of a Google Cloud OAuth app with the Google Drive API enabled (Google Cloud console > APIs & Services > Credentials)

refresh_token.description: a refresh token minted with that OAuth app for https://www.googleapis.com/auth/drive.readonly (or drive.metadata.readonly for metadata only)

notes: Own-account API: sees what the Google user who granted the refresh token can see. drive.readonly is a restricted scope; an app used outside its own Google Workspace may need Google's verification.
Responses are minimal by default; set fields to get more than id, name and mimeType (and nextPageToken for paging).
Google Docs, Sheets and Slides have no bytes to download; export them. Other files download with alt=media.

endpoints.name: Search files
endpoints.summary: Files and folders the user can access, filtered by a Drive query and sorted.

orderBy.description: Comma-separated keys, add ' desc' to reverse: createdTime, folder, modifiedByMeTime, modifiedTime, name, name_natural, quotaBytesUsed, recency, sharedWithMeTime, starred, viewedByMeTime.

corpora.description: Which collection to search; default user.

includeItemsFromAllDrives.description: Include shared-drive items as well as My Drive.

supportsAllDrives.description: Set true to reach files in shared drives.

fields.description: Which fields to return, e.g. 'nextPageToken,files(id,name,mimeType,modifiedTime,owners(emailAddress))'. Without it only kind, id, name and mimeType come back.

notes: Ask for nextPageToken in fields, or you cannot page. Shared-drive items need includeItemsFromAllDrives=true and supportsAllDrives=true.

endpoints.name: Get file metadata
endpoints.summary: A file's metadata: name, type, size, owners, dates, parents and links, as chosen by fields.

fileId.description: The file id (from files.list, or the /d/<id>/ part of a Drive URL).

supportsAllDrives.description: Set true to reach files in shared drives.

fields.description: Which fields to return, e.g. 'nextPageToken,files(id,name,mimeType,modifiedTime,owners(emailAddress))'. Without it only kind, id, name and mimeType come back.

endpoints.name: Download a file's content
endpoints.summary: The bytes of a file stored in Drive (PDF, image, upload). Not for Google Docs, Sheets or Slides.

fileId.description: The file id (from files.list, or the /d/<id>/ part of a Drive URL).

alt.description: Must be 'media' to get the content instead of metadata.

acknowledgeAbuse.description: Accept the risk of downloading a file flagged as malware; only for the file's owner or shared drive organizer.

supportsAllDrives.description: Set true to reach files in shared drives.

notes: Google Workspace files (Docs, Sheets, Slides) answer an error here; use files.export.

endpoints.name: Export a Google Doc, Sheet or Slides file
endpoints.summary: A Google Workspace document converted to another format: text, Markdown, PDF, CSV, Office.

fileId.description: The file id (from files.list, or the /d/<id>/ part of a Drive URL).

mimeType.description: Target format, as a full MIME type. Docs: text/plain, text/markdown, text/html, application/pdf, application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.document. Sheets: text/csv (first sheet only), application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet, application/pdf. Slides: text/plain, application/pdf, application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.presentationml.presentation.

notes: Exported content is limited to 10 MB.

endpoints.name: Get the user and storage quota
endpoints.summary: The signed-in user, storage quota and, on request, import and export formats.

fields.description: Required here: which fields, e.g. 'user,storageQuota' or 'exportFormats'.
